# Load libraries
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(spData)
library(spDataLarge)
```

# Prepare data
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# read in sea surface temperature rasters
sst_2008 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_2009 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_2010 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_2011 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_2012 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")

# read in bathmetry raster
ocean_depth <- rast("data/depth.tif")

# read in West Coast exclsuive economic zones (EEZ)
eez <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp")
```

```{r}
# Stack rasters
sst_stack <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)
```

```{r}
# Find mean of raster stack
sst_mean <- mean(sst_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Ensure stack includes all 5 rasters
plot(sst_mean)
```

```{r}
# Check CRS' are all the same
st_crs(sst_mean)
st_crs(ocean_depth)
st_crs(eez)
```

```{r}
# Check to make sure CRS' match! 
if(st_crs(sst_mean) == st_crs(eez)){
  print("crs matches!")
}else{
  warning("crs does not match")
  print(paste("rasters have", st_crs(eez), "crs"))
  }
```
